procedural_matters: GER 696 was represented by Katharina SCHWACHHOFER.
BEL 18 was represented by Isaura MAENHAUT.
Mark ASQUITH (coach of GER 696) attended the hearing as an observer.
The International Jury presented tracking and video evidence.
The International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: The conditions at the time of the incident were 6 - 7 knots of wind and flat water.
BEL 18 rounded mark 1, gybed at the mark and was sailing on the run on port tack, at less than 2 knots.
GER 696 was sailing close-hauled on port tack, 1 boat length below the port layline to mark 1.
BEL 18 was overlapped to windward of GER 696, both on converging courses.
When the boats were 2 boat lengths apart, GER 696 luffed by more than 20º and passed approximately 20cm behind BEL 18’s starboard tiller extension.
conclusions: BEL 18 to windward failed to keep clear of GER 696 to leeward, and broke RRS 11.
